'''Garalon Greymane''' (sometimes spelled as "'''Garaleon'''")<ref name="Aldrin, Protector of the Realm">[[Aldrin, Protector of the Realm]]</ref> was the first king of the nation and [[Gilneas (kingdom)|kingdom of Gilneas]], having established the kingdom after the city-state split away from the [[Empire of Arathor]] following a war of independence.

According to Gilnean legend, Garalon was a minor Arathorian noble who founded the kingdom of Gilneas after winning its independence from the Empire of Arathor, leading a rebellion against King [[Thoradin III]] of Arathor as he saw the Arathorian nobles who influenced the city-state as corrupt and oppressive. Gilneas had become independent after Dalaran, but before nations such as Alterac and Kul Tiras, which remains a point of pride for Gilneans. Rallying the other nobles of the state, Garalon declared himself the king of Gilneas, an act that Arathor could not tolerate. An army was sent to Gilneas to pacify it, leading to a war that saw Gilneas rise as an independent nation and led to the death of Thoradin III. Though Thoradin's heir, Prince [[Lenarol I]]<ref name="TheSilverpineWars">[[The Silverpine Wars]]</ref>, sued for peace and bestowed upon them the lands of the Gilnean peninsula into [[Silverpine Forest]], the budding nation of Gilneas was invaded by the neighboring nation of Dalaran soon after. Gilneas emerged victorious against the Dalaranian incursion, though the nation came under threat once more when a rebellion erupted to remove King Garalon from power. With the help of Garalon's favored general, Lord [[Aldrin Ravenwood]], the rebellion was subdued.<ref name="TheFirstGreymane">[[The First Greymane]]</ref> After Gilneas had established its independence from Arathor, they established their capital within the [[Gilneas City|city of Gilneas]] in the western peaks of the peninsula.<ref>[[Patch 1.17.0#Dungeons|Patch 1.17.0 - Gilneas City overview]]</ref>

Garalon later supported the secession of [[Kul Tiras (kingdom)|Kul Tiras]] and [[Alterac (kingdom)|Alterac]] from Arathor, though Garalon was assassinated at the age of 43 by the very Alteraci nobles he had supported just years before.<ref name="TheFirstGreymane" /> Garalon's son was mentored and regented by Lord Ravenwood after Garalon's death, ensuring that the young prince would be prepared to take the throne upon coming of age.<ref name="Aldrin, Protector of the Realm" />
